T012 : ∀ (n m : ℕ) (u : WSpace n × ℝ → WTarget m) (q : WTarget m),
  (∀ (t : ℝ), 0 < t → Integrable (fun x => wDensity u (x, t)) volume ∧ ∃ C R B, wLocal u q t C R B) →
    (∀ (t : ℝ),
        0 < t →
          ∀ (j : Fin n),
            (ContDiff ℝ ∞ fun x => wG u j (x, t)) ∧
              (HasCompactSupport fun x => wG u j (x, t)) ∧
                ∀ (x : WSpace n), wX (wG u j) j (x, t) = wB u j (x, t) + wC u j (x, t)) →
      (∀ (f : WSpace n → ℝ),
          ContDiff ℝ ∞ f →
            HasCompactSupport f →
              ∀ (j : Fin n), Integrable (fun x => wDx f j x) volume ∧ ∫ (x : WSpace n), wDx f j x = 0) →
        ∀ (t : ℝ),
          0 < t →
            ∀ (j : Fin n),
              Integrable (fun x => wB u j (x, t)) volume ∧
                Integrable (fun x => wC u j (x, t)) volume ∧
                  ∫ (x : WSpace n), wB u j (x, t) = -∫ (x : WSpace n), wC u j (x, t)
'Translation.T012' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
